tool.name: end_call_spanish
tool.description: Ends the call for a caller who tells their matter in Spanish. A Spanish greeting, name, place or word alone, or an accent, is not that: carry on in English. Call it at once, in a turn with no speech of your own: the phone system itself then tells them in Spanish that the owner will call them back at this number, and says goodbye.

messages.text: El dueño le devolverá la llamada a este número. Gracias por llamar. Adiós.
